haunting--adj.def: Beautiful or sad in a way you cannot forget.
haunting--adj.ex: The song has a haunting tune.
haunting--adj.exTr: Şarkının akıldan çıkmayan bir ezgisi var.

carve--verb.def: To cut a shape out of wood or stone.
carve--verb.ex: He carved a bird from olive wood.

hybrid--adj.def: Made by combining two different things.

chunk--noun.def: A thick solid piece of something.

commerce--noun.def: The buying and selling of goods on a large scale.

transcript--noun.def: A written copy of speech, or a record of grades.

trivial--adj.ex: They argued over a trivial matter.

imprisonment--noun.def: The punishment of being kept in prison.
imprisonment--noun.ex: He faces five years of imprisonment.
imprisonment--noun.exTr: Beş yıl hapis cezasıyla karşı karşıya.

deliberate--adj.def: Done on purpose rather than by accident.

venue--noun.def: The place where an event is held.

irritating--adj.def: Annoying in a way that is hard to ignore.

offender--noun.def: A person who has broken the law.

penetrate--verb.def: To go into or through something.

patriot--noun.def: A person who strongly loves their country.

thrilling--adj.def: Very exciting to watch or to do.

pancake--noun.def: A thin flat cake fried in a pan.

crater--noun.def: A large hole in the ground made by an explosion or a volcano.
crater--noun.ex: The crater is deep and wide.

stability--noun.def: The state of being steady and not likely to change.

pluck--verb.def: To pull something quickly from where it grows.
pluck--verb.ex: She plucked a flower from the hedge.

surge--noun.def: A sudden strong increase or movement.
surge--noun.ex: There was a surge in demand.

cone--noun.def: A shape with a round base and a point on top.
cone--noun.ex: An orange cone marked the hole.

pedal--noun.def: A part you press with your foot to work a machine.

coaching--noun.def: The work of training a person or a team.
coaching--noun.ex: He gave up coaching last year.

inspect--verb.def: To look at something carefully to check it.

irresistible--adj.def: So attractive that you cannot refuse it.

sparrow--noun.def: A small brown bird common in towns.
sparrow--noun.ex: A sparrow hopped along the wall.

immortality--noun.def: The state of living or being remembered for ever.

profitable--adj.def: Making money, or bringing a useful result.

vitamin--noun.def: A substance in food that the body needs to stay healthy.
vitamin--noun.ex: Oranges are rich in vitamin C.

goodwill--noun.def: A friendly and helpful attitude towards others.
goodwill--noun.ex: The visit was a gesture of goodwill.

compensate--verb.def: To pay someone for a loss, or to make up for something.
compensate--verb.ex: Nothing can compensate for lost time.
compensate--verb.exTr: Hiçbir şey kaybedilen zamanı telafi edemez.

outbreak--noun.def: The sudden start of a disease or a war.

desperation--noun.def: The feeling of having no hope and needing help badly.
desperation--noun.ex: He sold the farm out of desperation.

influential--adj.def: Having the power to change what others think or do.

tyrant--noun.def: A ruler who uses power cruelly.

firstly--adv.def: Used to introduce the first point.
firstly--adv.ex: Firstly, we must agree a budget.

subtitle--noun.def: Words on a screen translating speech, or a second title.

remark--noun.def: Something you say giving an opinion.

competent--adj.def: Having enough skill to do something well.

conquest--noun.def: The act of taking control of a country by force.

stepmother--noun.def: The woman married to your father but not your mother.

revive--verb.def: To bring something back to life or into use again.

unnatural--adj.def: Different from what is normal in nature.

popularity--noun.def: The state of being liked by many people.

hesitation--noun.def: A pause before acting because you are unsure.

jog--noun.def: A slow run taken for exercise.
jog--noun.ex: He went for an early jog.

unlimited--adj.def: Without any limit in amount or time.

vinegar--noun.def: A sour liquid used in cooking and for pickles.

remarkably--adv.def: To a degree that is surprising.

financially--adv.def: In a way relating to money.

clam--noun.def: A sea creature with two shells that can be eaten.
clam--noun.ex: They dug for clams at low tide.

blur--verb.def: To make something unclear or hard to see.

descend--verb.def: To move down from a higher place.
descend--verb.ex: The path descends to the river.

grieve--verb.def: To feel very sad, especially after a death.

awe--noun.def: A feeling of deep respect mixed with wonder.

surroundings--noun.def: The things and conditions around a person or a place.

cardboard--noun.def: Thick stiff paper used for boxes.

cooperative--adj.def: Willing to work helpfully with others.

diploma--noun.def: A certificate showing you completed a course.

rural--adj.def: Relating to the countryside rather than a town.

immoral--adj.def: Wrong according to accepted standards of behaviour.

usher--verb.def: To lead someone politely to a place.

holder--noun.def: A device for holding something, or a person who owns it.
holder--noun.ex: Every ticket holder gets a seat.
holder--noun.exTr: Her bilet sahibine bir koltuk var.

merge--verb.def: To join two things into one.
merge--verb.ex: The two banks merged last year.

journalism--noun.def: The work of collecting and writing news.

blaze--verb.def: To burn very brightly and strongly.
blaze--verb.exTr: Ateş bütün gece alev alev yandı.

offshore--adj.def: In the sea away from the coast.
offshore--adj.ex: They built an offshore wind farm.
offshore--adj.exTr: Açık denizde bir rüzgâr çiftliği kurdular.

fiber--noun.def: A thin thread, or the part of food that helps digestion.
